guitar.notes: Talk Talk's sound centered on keyboards/synths/production; guitar is secondary with no iconic instrument tied to the band.

tone.target: bright chorus-clean with subtle breakup and delay
tone.profile: bright chorus-clean with subtle breakup and delay
tone.summary: A bright, shimmering signal chain utilizing Chorus for texture, a light boost/OD for clean edge breakup, followed by a classic British clean amp model (UK 50) and ample delay/reverb for depth.
